answer: Bonded attestation bet. Every voter locks stake in escrow first. Votes matching final consensus return the stake plus a fee. Votes disproven in the challenge window forfeit the bond to the challenger. Sybils must pre-fund every fake identity, so a crowd of puppets on the tundra of idle wallets costs real capital. Clusters vouching only for each other form karst-like hollows, and a whisper of outside stake never reaches them, so their endorsements settle for nothing.
